text: verily: Heb. in truth and stableness
Commit thy way unto the LORD: Heb. roll thy way upon the Lord
rest in the LORD: Heb. be silent to the LORD
such as be of upright conversation: Heb. the upright of way
the fat of lambs: Heb. the preciousness of Lambs
a green bay tree: Or, a green tree, that groweth in his own soil
